objective: Consume Model 1 observations and generate a patient-facing, non-diagnostic wellbeing report.

cognitive_summary.memory_status: Gentle summary without raw scores or diagnosis
cognitive_summary.language_status: Gentle summary without raw scores or diagnosis
cognitive_summary.processing_speed: Gentle summary without raw scores or diagnosis

alerts_and_flags.cognitive_decline_indicators: List of observations only; never clinical red flags

recommendations.clinical_action: Use non-diagnostic wording and recommend professional discussion for persistent concerns
recommendations.next_session_adjustments: Suggested app-level adjustments such as language or activity difficulty

instructions: Strict JSON. Do not expose raw scores in the patient-facing view. Do not diagnose, screen, predict, or rule out a condition.
